summary: Verified the new fixed-list 'Meeting Type' dropdown (14 fixed + Other free-text) end-to-end. All 25 backend pytest cases passed and all 10 frontend UI assertions passed. Existing legacy meetings with old lowercase meeting_type values still load in list and detail views without errors — no regression.

coverage: Pydantic blank/whitespace meeting_type rejected with 'meeting_type must not be blank'

POST /api/meetings/ succeeds for each of the 14 new fixed strings (Supervision, Appraisal, Competency assessment, Disciplinary, Grievance, Safeguarding investigation, Learner Review, Probation review, Absence review, Exit interview, Team meeting, Incident review, Audit review, Quality assurance review) and echoes value back
POST /api/meetings/ with meeting_type='Custom test type' (Other free-text) accepted and persisted
POST /api/meetings/ with meeting_type='' -> 422 with 'meeting_type' in error
POST /api/meetings/ with meeting_type omitted -> defaults to 'Supervision'
GET /api/meetings/ list loads (legacy lowercase types visible, no error)
GET /api/meetings/{id} detail loads for 10 existing meetings with legacy meeting_type values

checks: Dropdown renders exactly 15 options in exact expected order (Supervision..Quality assurance review, Other)
Selecting 'Disciplinary' updates title preview to start with 'Disciplinary'
Custom input (data-testid='meeting-type-custom-input') hidden by default, appears only when 'Other' is selected
Typing 'My Weird Type' into custom input updates title preview to 'My Weird Type'
Selecting Other + leaving custom empty + clicking Create shows 'Please enter a custom meeting type' error and stays on /meetings/new
Full flow: select attendee (Demo Manager) + Other + 'Custom test type' + Create -> navigates to /meetings/{id}/prepare successfully
Title preview correctly composes as 'Custom test type with Demo Manager'

critical_code_review_comments: Minor (not blocking): buildTitle() falls back to 'Meeting' when meetingType is empty; combined with effectiveMeetingType default of 'Other' this is currently unreachable but the fallback is a small dead branch.
Minor: the 'Other' option is appended after MEETING_TYPES.map() rather than being part of the constant — harmless, but the constant could equivalently include it for consistency.
test_credentials: admin@supervision.com / Admin123!X (MFA optional, was not required in this session)
seed_data_creation: 17 TEST_-prefixed meetings created via POST /api/meetings/ then deleted in cleanup step; 1 additional meeting created via UI (id fe4c0ac5-0563-4e9a-af74-a19d1e878707, title 'Custom test type with Demo Manager') left in DB — safe to delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_meeting_type_dropdown.py is a stable regression suite for the meeting_type validator + full 14+Other option list; re-run any time this dropdown is touched. It hits real POST /api/meetings/ and cleans up after itself.
